sample_unit: chest X-rays (1,000 balanced + 1,300 real-world KKH; 5,856 Kermany)
unlisted_practices: Ensembling multiple MLLM agents with soft voting, majority voting, or LLM aggregation to improve diagnostic discrimination without fine-tuning

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of an ensembled multimodal large language model (MedGemma) on pediatric chest X-rays across internal and external retrospective datasets. It evaluates model aggregation/ensembling techniques rather than operational health care deployment practices or safeguards.
